note: Telemetry name map for tools/telemetrynames (make telemetry-names). Every log event (`<area>.<event>`, the first string argument of a slog call) and every metric name (the static tail after the program prefix) in non-test Go code under code_dirs must appear as a whole token in the ONE spec its log area or metric tail prefix maps to; being listed only in another spec still fails. Specs only (docs/specs/), never READMEs. An unmapped area fails: add it here, mapped to the spec that owns the workflow (03 to 03n) or to 05b for platform signals. Metric keys match the longest prefix of the name after `<metric prefix>_`. Names in a mapped spec with no code are a report only until plan row 17.
